text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Jalan Persekutuan

(Lebuh Raya Pantai Timur–Fasa 2) 2014.

 (2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 21 November 2014.

Perisytiharan jalan sebagai jalan Persekutuan

2. (1) Bahagian jalan yang dikenali sebagai Lebuh Raya Pantai Timur–Fasa 2

yang bermula—

(a) dari kilometer 250.620 di koordinat U+88993.651000,

T+245032.711000 Grid Rectified Skew Orthomorphic (RSO)

Geosentrik (GDM 2000) dan berakhir di kilometer 308.395 di

koordinat U+139701.958199, T+253267.935800 Grid RSO

Geosentrik (GDM 2000), termasuklah Persimpangan Bertingkat

Cheneh, Persimpangan Bertingkat Cukai, Persimpangan Bertingkat

Kijal dan jalan-jalan sambungannya suatu jarak sepanjang 57.775

kilometer; dan

(b) dari kilometer 329.387 di koordinat U+158623.184142,

T+251519.143657 Grid RSO Geosentrik (GDM 2000) dan berakhir

di kilometer 433.977 di koordinat U+243442.227735,

T+213048.376897 Grid RSO Geosentrik (GDM 2000), termasuklah

Persimpangan Bertingkat Paka, Persimpangan Bertingkat Kuala

Dungun, Persimpangan Bertingkat Bukit Besi, Persimpangan

Bertingkat Ajil, Persimpangan Jalan Telemung, Persimpangan

Bertingkat Telemung, Persimpangan Bertingkat Kuala Terengganu

dan jalan-jalan sambungannya suatu jarak sepanjang

104.590 kilometer,

diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan.

(2) Jalan yang diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan di bawah

subperenggan (1) ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual.

Pembatalan

3. Perintah Jalan Persekutuan (Lebuh Raya Pantai Timur–Fasa 2)

2014 [P.U. (A) 1/2014] dibatalkan.

JADUAL

[Subperenggan 2(2)]

PETA LEBUH RAYA PANTAI TIMUR–FASA 2

Dibuat 19 November 2014

[KKR.PUU. 110-1/7/3/2 (29); PN(PU2)391/XXVIII]

DATUK HAJI FADILLAH BIN HAJI YUSOF

Menteri Kerja Raya

[Akan dibentangkan di Dewan Rakyat menurut seksyen 4 Akta Jalan Persekutuan 1959]

FEDERAL ROADS ACT 1959

FEDERAL ROADS (EAST COAST EXPRESSWAY–PHASE 2) ORDER 2014

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 3 of the Federal Roads Act 1959

[Act 376], the Minister, after consultation with the State Government of Terengganu,

makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (East Coast

Expressway–Phase 2) Order 2014.

 (2) This Order comes into operation on 21 November 2014.

Declaration of road to be Federal road

2. (1) The part of the road known as the East Coast Expressway–Phase 2

commencing—

(a) from kilometre 250.620 at coordinates N+88993.651000,

E+245032.711000 Rectified Skew Orthomorphic (RSO) Geocentric

(GDM 2000) Grid and ending at kilometre 308.395 at coordinates

N+139701.958199, E+253267.935800 RSO Geocentric (GDM

2000) Grid, including Cheneh Interchange, Cukai Interchange,

Kijal Interchange and its link roads a distance of 57.775 kilometres;

and

 (b) from kilometre 329.387 at coordinates N+158623.184142,

E+251519.143657 RSO Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid and ending at

kilometre 433.977 at coordinates N+243442.227735,

E+213048.376897 RSO Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid,

including Paka Interchange, Kuala Dungun Interchange, Bukit Besi

Interchange, Ajil Interchange, Telemung Road Junction, Telemung

Interchange, Kuala Terengganu Interchange and its link roads

a distance of 104.590 kilometres,

is declared to be a Federal road.

(2) The road declared to be Federal road under subparagraph (1) is shown

on the map in the Schedule.

Revocation

3. The Federal Roads (East Coast Expressway–Phase 2) Order 2014

[P.U. (A) 1/2014] is revoked.

SCHEDULE

[Subparagraph 2(2)]
